caption:
monsoon season calls for my favorite aloo parathas and this recipe makes lovely packed with masala parathas that taste even better with cold dahi.

i use standard roti dough for the parathas and this recipe can be preped and ready within an hour so run to your kitchen and get started :)

Ingredients: 

- 4 -5 potatoes, peeled and boiled
- 2 green chillies, finely chopped
- 2 tbsp coriander leaves, finely chopped 
- 1 onion, minced
- 1/2 tsp ginger garlic paste
- 1 tsp ground cumin
- 1/2 tsp red chilli powder
- 1/2 tsp coriander powder
- 1/2 tsp garam masala
- 1 tsp aamchur powder ( usually go with 1/2 tsp but 1 is my personal preference) 
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/2 tsp turmeric
